features.description: Product model exposes all BRD fields with correct types
steps: Construct a Product with all BRD fields populated
Assert product_id, name, description, brand, category, gender, color, price, image_url, stock, tags are accessible
Assert price is decimal and stock is int and tags is a list

features.description: Category enum is restricted to the five allowed values
steps: Enumerate Category values
Assert the set equals {Shoes, Clothing, Accessories, Sportswear, Bags}
Assert assigning an out-of-set value raises a validation error

features.description: Gender enum is restricted to the four allowed values
steps: Enumerate Gender values
Assert the set equals {Men, Women, Unisex, Kids}

features.description: QueryFilters holds optional brand/color/category/gender/min_price/max_price defaulting to None
steps: Construct QueryFilters with no arguments
Assert all six fields default to None

features.description: Product missing name, price, or category raises a validation error
steps: Attempt to construct a Product omitting name
Assert a validation error is raised
Repeat for missing price and missing category

features.description: Product with stock=0 exposes derived in_stock=False
steps: Construct a valid Product with stock=0
Assert the product is created without error
Assert derived in_stock is False

features.description: Settings load all required secrets and connection params from environment
steps: Set all required env vars
Load settings
Assert GOOGLE_API_KEY, PINECONE_API_KEY, and all MYSQL_* values are populated

features.description: .env.example lists every required key with placeholder values and .env is gitignored
steps: Open .env.example and assert it contains all required keys
Assert .gitignore contains an entry matching .env

features.description: Missing required setting raises a clear error naming the key
steps: Unset MYSQL_HOST
Attempt to load settings
Assert the raised error message names MYSQL_HOST

features.description: Settings expose typed model/index defaults (index name, embedding model, generation model, dim 768)
steps: Load settings without overriding defaults
Assert EMBEDDING_MODEL == text-embedding-004 and GENERATION_MODEL == gemini-1.5-flash
Assert EMBEDDING_DIM == 768 and PINECONE_INDEX_NAME is set

features.description: get_logger returns a structured logger with timestamp, level, name, and message
steps: Call get_logger('test') and emit an info record
Assert the emitted record contains timestamp, level, logger name, and message fields

features.description: Logger supports a session_id/request_id correlation field and configurable level
steps: Emit a log with session_id context bound
Assert session_id appears in the record
Set log level env var to DEBUG and assert debug records are emitted

features.description: No log statement emits raw API key values
steps: Scan the codebase for log calls referencing GOOGLE_API_KEY or PINECONE_API_KEY values
Assert none log the secret values directly

features.description: products table is created with all required columns and NOT NULL constraints
steps: Run the schema init script against a clean MySQL 8 instance
Describe the products table
Assert columns product_id, name(NOT NULL), category(NOT NULL), price(NOT NULL), and all other BRD fields exist

features.description: category and gender columns are constrained to BRD enum value sets
steps: Attempt to insert a row with category outside the allowed enum
Assert the insert is rejected by constraint or application validation

features.description: Schema init script is idempotent and product_id is the primary key
steps: Run the schema init script twice
Assert the second run does not error and no duplicate table is created
Insert two rows with the same product_id and assert the second is rejected

features.description: upsert_product inserts new rows and updates existing rows by product_id
steps: upsert_product with a new product_id and assert it is inserted
upsert_product again with the same product_id but changed price
Assert the row is updated, not duplicated

features.description: get_products_by_ids returns full records preserving input ordering
steps: Seed three products
Call get_products_by_ids with IDs in a specific order
Assert returned products match that order

features.description: list_products applies filters and returns all when no filters supplied
steps: Call list_products with brand=Nike and assert only Nike products return
Call list_products with no filters and assert all products return

features.description: get_products_by_ids with empty list returns empty without querying DB
steps: Call get_products_by_ids with an empty list
Assert an empty list is returned and no SQL query is issued

features.description: MySQL connection failure raises a typed repository error not a raw driver exception
steps: Point the repository at an unreachable MySQL host
Invoke a repository method
Assert a typed repository error is raised rather than a raw driver exception

features.description: Valid CSV row parses into a Product object
steps: Provide a CSV row with all required fields
Run the loader
Assert a Product object is produced with matching values

features.description: Row missing a required field is skipped and recorded as a validation failure
steps: Provide a CSV row missing price
Run the loader
Assert the row is not in valid products and is recorded with row id and reason

features.description: Row with out-of-enum category or gender is skipped and recorded
steps: Provide a CSV row with category=Laptops
Run the loader
Assert the row is skipped and recorded as a validation failure

features.description: tags string is parsed into a list of trimmed strings and loader returns valid+failures
steps: Provide a row with tags 'Running, Sports , Casual'
Run the loader and assert tags == ['Running','Sports','Casual']
Assert loader returns both a valid-products list and a failures list

features.description: build_embedding_text concatenates semantic fields and excludes price/stock/image
steps: Call build_embedding_text on a product
Assert output contains name, description, brand, category, gender, color, tags
Assert output contains no price, stock, or image URL

features.description: Missing optional fields are omitted without literal None text and example reads coherently
steps: Call build_embedding_text on a product with no color and no tags
Assert the word 'None' does not appear in the output
Run on the BRD example and assert it contains Nike, running shoes, men, Shoes, and tags

features.description: embed_text returns a 768-dim vector using text-embedding-004
steps: Call embed_text on a sample string with the embedding client (mock returns 768 floats)
Assert the returned vector length is exactly 768
Assert the configured model is text-embedding-004

features.description: embed_batch returns one ordered 768-dim vector per input text
steps: Call embed_batch with three texts
Assert three vectors returned in input order, each length 768

features.description: Gemini embedding error is re-raised as a typed embedding error and client uses settings
steps: Force the embedding backend to raise an SDK error
Assert a typed embedding error is raised, not the raw SDK exception
Assert the client reads API key and model from centralized settings

features.description: Pinecone client connects using settings and reuses an existing index
steps: Initialize the Pinecone client with a configured (existing) index
Assert connection uses PINECONE_API_KEY from settings
Assert the existing index is reused without error

features.description: Missing index is created with dimension 768 and cosine metric; wrong dim is flagged
steps: Initialize with a non-existent index name
Assert it is created with dimension 768 and cosine metric
Attempt creation with dimension != 768 and assert it is flagged as a config mismatch

features.description: Pinecone connection failure raises a typed retrieval error
steps: Force a Pinecone connection failure
Assert a typed retrieval error is raised that maps to the BRD user message

features.description: upsert_products writes one vector per product keyed by product_id with metadata
steps: Call upsert_products with products and matching vectors (mock Pinecone)
Assert one vector per product keyed by product_id
Assert each vector carries brand, color, category, gender, price metadata

features.description: Re-upserting same product_id overwrites prior vector and stores price as numeric
steps: Upsert a product then upsert again with the same id and different metadata
Assert no duplicate vector exists and metadata is overwritten
Assert price metadata is numeric so range filters apply

features.description: Upsert is batched so 500-1000 products load in one run within request limits
steps: Upsert 1000 products via upsert_products
Assert requests are batched (multiple bounded batches, not one oversized request)
Assert all 1000 vectors are present afterward

features.description: Ingestion script runs CSV end-to-end into MySQL and Pinecone
steps: Run the ingestion script on a sample CSV (mocked Gemini/Pinecone)
Assert valid rows are upserted into MySQL
Assert corresponding vectors are upserted into Pinecone

features.description: CSV-validation failures and embedding failures are non-fatal and counted
steps: Include one invalid CSV row and one product whose embedding call fails
Run ingestion and assert the run completes without aborting
Assert both failures are counted and the failed product is excluded from Pinecone

features.description: Ingestion prints a summary with processed/successful/failed counts and reasons; rerun upserts
steps: Run ingestion and assert a summary prints total processed, successful, failed, and failure reasons
Re-run on the same CSV and assert records are updated, not duplicated, in MySQL and Pinecone

features.description: Filter extraction maps a full NL query to correct structured filters
steps: Extract filters from 'Show me red Nike shoes under 3000' (mock Gemini JSON)
Assert result equals {brand: Nike, color: Red, category: Shoes, max_price: 3000}

features.description: Synonyms normalize to canonical enums (Crimson->Red, Trainers->Shoes)
steps: Extract filters from a query using 'Crimson' and 'Trainers'
Assert color normalizes to Red and category normalizes to Shoes

features.description: Unknown enum values are dropped to None and price-only queries extract max_price
steps: Extract from a query naming an unknown color and assert that field is None
Extract from 'under 500' and assert max_price=500 with all other filters None

features.description: Malformed/non-JSON model output yields empty QueryFilters without crashing
steps: Force the model to return non-JSON text
Run extraction
Assert an empty QueryFilters (all None) is returned and no exception propagates

features.description: Hybrid retriever applies brand/color/category/gender as Pinecone equality filters
steps: Call retrieve with filters brand=Nike, category=Shoes (mock Pinecone)
Assert the Pinecone query includes equality metadata filters for those fields

features.description: min_price/max_price applied as numeric range filters and results ordered by similarity
steps: Call retrieve with max_price=3000
Assert a numeric range filter on price metadata is sent to Pinecone
Assert returned results are ordered by similarity score

features.description: Retriever returns at most 5 IDs and empty list when filters exclude all vectors
steps: Call retrieve against a populated mock and assert at most 5 IDs returned
Call retrieve with filters matching nothing and assert an empty list with no error

features.description: Hydration returns full Product objects for retrieved IDs preserving rank order
steps: Hydrate a ranked ID list [id3, id1, id2]
Assert full Product objects are returned in that exact order

features.description: ID missing in MySQL is skipped and logged; empty ID list returns empty without query
steps: Hydrate a list containing one ID not present in MySQL and assert it is skipped and logged
Hydrate an empty list and assert empty result with no MySQL query issued

features.description: Each session has isolated accumulating filters and turn history
steps: Create session A and session B
Update filters in session A
Assert session B filters are unchanged

features.description: Session state can be reset to empty filters
steps: Set filters on a session
Call reset
Assert the session filters are all None

features.description: Session state is in-memory only and history is bounded
steps: Add more than N turns to a session and assert history is capped at the bound
Assert no cross-session persistence store is written (memory only)

features.description: Generation prompt includes only retrieved products as context
steps: Invoke generation with two retrieved products (mock Gemini)
Inspect the assembled prompt
Assert it contains only those two products as context

features.description: Generated answer references only products present in context (grounding)
steps: Generate with a known product set
Assert no product name absent from the context appears in the reply

features.description: Empty context yields a no-match message suggesting categories, using gemini-1.5-flash
steps: Invoke generation with empty context
Assert the reply is a friendly no-match suggesting available categories and invents no product
Assert the configured generation model is gemini-1.5-flash

features.description: Gemini generation failure returns the BRD user-facing message, not a stack trace
steps: Force a Gemini generation failure
Assert the response is 'The AI assistant is temporarily unavailable...' with no stack trace

features.description: Refinement merges onto session filters and rebuilds a fresh hybrid retrieval
steps: Turn 1: 'Show me Nike shoes'; Turn 2: 'only red ones'
Assert turn 2 filters include brand=Nike, category=Shoes, color=Red
Assert a fresh retrieval is run rather than filtering the prior result list

features.description: 'Cheaper options' lowers the upper price ceiling and re-runs retrieval
steps: Establish a session with a max_price
Send 'cheaper options'
Assert max_price is reduced and retrieval is re-run for lower-priced items

features.description: Category change or explicit reset clears accumulated filter state
steps: Build up filters then send 'Now show me bags'
Assert prior brand/color filters are cleared and category becomes Bags
Send 'forget previous search' and assert all filters reset

features.description: Empty result set yields no-match message with category suggestions and zero cards
steps: Query for something with no catalog matches
Assert the reply is a friendly no-match with category suggestions
Assert zero product cards are returned

features.description: Greetings/invalid queries return scoped response without retrieving products
steps: Send 'hi' and assert a scoped capability response with no retrieval
Send 'asdfgh' and assert a clarification response with no products

features.description: Each chat turn returns an NL message plus up to 5 grounded product cards
steps: Send a normal product query
Assert the response contains an NL message and at most 5 grounded product cards

features.description: GET /api/health returns 200 with a JSON status body
steps: Call GET /api/health
Assert status 200 and a JSON body containing a status field

features.description: CORS allows the Streamlit frontend origin
steps: Send a preflight/CORS request from the Streamlit origin
Assert the response permits that origin

features.description: Unhandled exceptions and service errors return structured JSON with no stack trace, mapped to BRD messages
steps: Trigger an unhandled error in a route and assert a structured JSON error with appropriate status and no stack trace
Trigger a Gemini/Pinecone/MySQL typed error and assert the response is the corresponding BRD user message

features.description: Each request is logged with method, path, and status without secrets
steps: Make a request and inspect logs
Assert method, path, and status are logged and no secret values appear

features.description: POST /api/chat accepts {session_id, message} and returns reply plus <=5 products
steps: POST /api/chat with a valid session_id and message
Assert 200 with body containing reply (string) and products (<=5 items)

features.description: Different session_id values maintain independent conversation state
steps: Send refining turns under session_id A
Send a fresh query under session_id B
Assert B's results are unaffected by A's accumulated filters

features.description: Missing/empty message returns 422 and service failure returns mapped BRD message
steps: POST /api/chat with empty message and assert 422 validation error
Force a downstream service failure and assert the mapped BRD user message with a non-leaking error shape

features.description: Typical chat query responds in under 5 seconds
steps: POST /api/chat with a typical query against a seeded catalog
Measure round-trip latency
Assert response time is under 5 seconds

features.description: GET /api/products returns catalog with display fields and stock status
steps: Call GET /api/products with no filters
Assert a list of products each with image, name, brand, category, price, and stock status

features.description: GET /api/products applies structured filter query params
steps: Call GET /api/products?brand=Nike&category=Shoes&max_price=3000
Assert only matching products are returned

features.description: GET /api/filters returns distinct option values for UI controls
steps: Call GET /api/filters
Assert distinct brands, categories, genders, and colors are returned

features.description: No-match filter returns empty list with 200 and stock status reflects stock=0
steps: Call GET /api/products with a filter matching nothing and assert 200 with empty list
Assert a product with stock=0 is surfaced as out of stock

features.description: Catalog grid renders product cards fetched from /api/products
steps: Load the Streamlit app
Assert it fetches GET /api/products and renders a grid of cards

features.description: Each card shows image, name, brand, category, price, and stock status
steps: Inspect a rendered card
Assert image, name, brand, category, price (INR), and stock status are visible
Assert a stock=0 product shows an out-of-stock indicator

features.description: Catalog endpoint unavailable shows a friendly message not a stack trace
steps: Make the catalog endpoint unavailable
Load the app and assert a friendly message is shown with no stack trace

features.description: Filter controls render and are populated from /api/filters
steps: Load the app
Assert Brand, Category, Gender, Color controls and a Price Range slider are rendered with options from GET /api/filters

features.description: Selecting filters re-queries products and combined filters intersect; clearing restores full grid
steps: Select Brand=Nike and Category=Shoes and assert the grid shows only products matching both
Clear filters and assert the full catalog grid is restored

features.description: Chat input submits NL query and displays the assistant reply with up to 5 cards
steps: Type a natural-language query and submit
Assert the assistant NL reply is displayed
Assert up to 5 product cards render inline with the reply

features.description: A stable session_id is generated per browser session and sent on every chat call
steps: Open a session and send two messages
Assert both POST /api/chat calls carry the same session_id

features.description: Multi-turn refinement updates results and transcript persists; no-match shows zero cards
steps: Send a query then a refinement 'only red ones' and assert results update within the same session
Assert previous turns remain visible in the transcript
Send a no-match query and assert the friendly message with zero cards

features.description: Unit tests cover filter normalization and price-only extraction with mocks
steps: Run the filter-extraction unit tests
Assert Crimson->Red and Trainers->Shoes cases pass with mocked Gemini
Assert price-only extraction test passes

features.description: Unit tests cover hybrid retrieval filters/limit and hydration ordering
steps: Run retrieval unit tests and assert metadata + range filters passed to mock Pinecone with <=5 IDs
Run hydration unit tests and assert rank order preserved and missing IDs skipped

features.description: Unit tests cover multi-turn accumulation and reset, with no live services
steps: Run multi-turn unit tests asserting refinement accumulates and category change resets
Assert the entire suite runs and passes with no live Gemini/Pinecone/MySQL connection

features.description: Integration test of /api/chat returns reply and <=5 products on seeded catalog
steps: Seed a test catalog and call POST /api/chat
Assert 200 with a reply and at most 5 products

features.description: Integration tests cover product filtering and multi-turn refinement
steps: Call GET /api/products with filters and assert correct filtered results
Run a multi-turn chat sequence and assert 'only red ones' changes results within one session

features.description: No-match integration test and core journey complete with no blocking errors
steps: Issue a no-match chat query and assert a graceful response with zero products
Run the full core journey (browse -> query -> refine -> no-match) and assert no blocking errors

features.description: Backend and frontend Dockerfiles build and compose defines backend/frontend/mysql
steps: Build the backend and frontend images
Assert docker-compose.yml defines backend, frontend, and mysql services on a shared network

features.description: docker-compose up brings the stack online with frontend->backend->mysql connectivity
steps: Run docker-compose up
Assert the Streamlit UI reaches the backend and the backend reaches MySQL

features.description: MySQL data persists via named volume and secrets are injected via env not baked into images
steps: Restart the mysql container and assert seeded data persists via the named volume
Inspect the built images and assert no secrets are baked in (injected via env/.env)

features.description: Schema initializes on first boot and init script bootstraps env and ingestion
steps: Start the stack on a clean volume and assert the products schema is created automatically
Run init.sh and assert it copies .env.example to .env if absent and runs ingestion

features.description: README documents dev and Docker run paths and a clean checkout yields a working app
steps: Assert README documents both dev mode (uvicorn + streamlit + local MySQL) and Docker mode
Follow the README from a clean checkout and assert the app is reachable in the browser
